name: agnohire
description: AgnoHire — Enterprise AI Recruitment Management Platform (ATS)

scripts.predev: npm run build:shared && npm run prisma:generate --workspace server
scripts.dev:server: npm run tools:generate --workspace server && npm run dev --workspace server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run tools:generate --workspace server && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:shared && npm run prisma:generate --workspace server && npm run db:up && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
scripts.sync: npm install && npm run build:shared && npm run prisma:generate --workspace server && npm run db:deploy
